Cable boxes both limit my ability to actually record the programs by requiring me to use a fixed amount of storage space and my ability to do exactly what I always did with the VCR - make the recording portable to other TVs in my house and skip commercials during playback - with time shifted programs.

Torrenting TV shows that I have access to either OTA (i.e. ABC, NBC, CBS programs) or via my cable subscription (AMC) with exactly the same utility that I had when VHS was the standard of the day.

Torrents are the modern equivalent of that for people who already have access to the broadcast. There's nothing torrenting a show that is on broadcast or cable to which I have a subscription gives me that I couldn't have done with a Betamax in 1984.
